source_policy: Each existing direct reaction independently; native 5m requires fast and 15m requires normal. Keep matched skip plus ungated control in identical KST hours. Original signals from both directions are retained; no breakout or close confirmation for direct touch.
gate: End at last fully completed 5s boundary. Count exchange trades in 18 consecutive nonoverlapping five-second buckets. Median count in first 15 buckets. In each of last three test count >= max(3,1.5 times median) AND side-aggressor quote notional >=60%. At least two qualifying buckets. Missing critical tick coverage is unverified.
exit: Parent B initial structure and full trail, day close 23:59. Compare same quantity with parent A and C, at same admissible entry. A/C +/-1%; risk and simultaneous-holding caps from parent. Record actual costs and carry across KST dates.
accounts: Each direction and source standalone plus shared 150. Same 3 slots, 3 USDT reserve, 3..5x, 0.5/2% risk, 5bp fee/side, 5bp slip/side actual funding; 10bp slip same quantity and separately resized. Preceding NAV carried, never reset. Idle included, no inferred PnL for missing.
promotion: Parent full 60-day inclusive daily 5..10% gate, 30 fills / 10 active days / 10 per half in each candidate, positive excluding best trade and instrument and under fixed-size stress, matched holdout, production comparator and drawdown review. Internal simulation only. Failure is retained for every calendar date; no change to live activation.
history: 11/22 diagnostic paths already inspected and 11/23 had already closed. Neither date nor partial 11/24 is untouched evidence for the new gate. No fitting to forward observations.

native_high_low_sensitivity.range: (high-low)/previous confirmed close. Same 3 versus preceding 36, strict Q75 and median native quote turnover. Use this direct candle range for the new gate; previously frozen native true-range speed also reported separately. Infer no entry or PnL from the number of windows.
